      spentL s lid + charge full a a ≤ b →
        spentT s + charge full a a ≤ G →
          ∀ (p : List Op),
            have t := run admins G full s p;
            (step admins G full t (Op.work w a a)).usage = t.usage ++ [(w, lid, a)] ∨
              t.halted = true ∨
                lid ∈ t.revoked ∨ leaseOf t w ≠ some lid ∨ spentL s lid < spentL t lid ∨ spentT s < spentT t
